title: Rigidity of the Turing degrees

result.label: Rigidity of the Turing degrees
result.statement: Every order automorphism of the Turing degrees is the identity, resolving their rigidity problem. Thus no nontrivial relabeling of degrees preserves the ordering by relative computability.
